criteria.reason: The stated global order incorrectly places the execution advisory after promotion and visibility; wake normally follows admission and can precede promotion.
The three receipt paths and pending, promoted and visible distinctions are integrated with the relevant provenance and comparison conditions.
The flow omits the continuation-versus-idle conditions governing steer and queue selection, and the responsibility section incorrectly orders wake after visibility.
Receipt, visibility and provider outcome are separated, with process-local, restart and hosted/recovery limits stated.
Actual assertion categories are distinguished from execution evidence and hypothetical test failures.
The coverage claim overlooks the incorrect advisory ordering and missing continuation/idle relation affecting IF-1 and IF-3.
Coupling is explained through identity, carriers, eligibility and coordination without making navigation an automatic rebuild dependency.

criteria.section: L3-IM / Integrated model; Consequences and boundaries
criteria.reason: Identity, context, time and provenance changes are mapped to distinct retry and projection obligations.
The impact matrix connects delivery and request changes to history and coordination changes to process-local responsibilities.
Preserving behavior is distinguished from intentional contract change and a hypothetical edit is not treated as a proven failure.
Bounded assertions and boundary-specific verification needs are separated from intent and unexecuted tests.
Cross-component coverage and missing implementation, atomicity and runtime evidence are retained without prescribing a new design.
Receipt, inbox, visibility, local activity and provider outcome are treated as distinct observations.

defects.passage: the maintainer-critical separation is durable receipt → promoted/visible state → process-local execution advisory → provider-turn request, in that order, with each later stage conditional on the earlier one.
defects.reason: This places the advisory wake after promotion and visibility, contradicting the admission-before-wake and wake-drain relationships.
defects.requiredCorrection: Describe wake as an advisory following admission, with promotion and visibility conditional on subsequent eligible processing; do not impose one universal order on retries or historical reconciliation.

defects.reason: The integrated flow does not state that continuation selects steers while queue selection is reconsidered when otherwise idle, so its queue timing is incomplete.
defects.requiredCorrection: Add the continuation and idle reevaluation conditions, preserving steer-first reevaluation and queue-then-eligible-steers behavior.
